description: Manages interactions with the AI assistant, including chat sessions, data processing, file analysis, and various session management functionalities.

endpoints.name: GetUserSessions
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all chat sessions for the current user with the AI assistant.
example_uses: Show me all my past conversations with the AI.
Can I see a list of my AI assistant sessions?
I need to view my chat history with Gemini.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to see a list of their previous interactions or chat sessions with the AI assistant.

endpoints.name: GetSessionDetails
endpoints.description: Fetches the detailed content and metadata of a specific AI assistant chat session.

req.description: Request body containing the session identifier to retrieve details for.

example_uses: Retrieve the full transcript of session ID 123.
Get the details for my chat with the AI about project Alpha.
Show me everything from the session where I discussed budget planning.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user needs to view the complete conversation or specific details of a particular AI assistant session.

endpoints.name: ChatWithGemini
endpoints.description: Initiates or continues a conversation with the AI assistant, sending a user message and receiving an AI response.

req.description: Request body containing the user's message and session context.

example_uses: Ask the AI assistant a question about the new policy.
Send a message to Gemini to get a summary of the report.
Continue my conversation with the AI about the project timeline.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to interact conversationally with the AI assistant, sending a query or message.

endpoints.name: ScanFile
endpoints.description: Scans a provided file for content analysis or processing by the AI.

req.description: Request body containing file details for scanning.

example_uses: Upload this document for the AI to scan.
Can the AI scan this file for key information?
Initiate a file scan for the attached report.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants the AI to process or analyze the content of a file.

endpoints.name: ProcessDataRelatedSummaryDetails
endpoints.description: Processes specific data to generate summaries or extract related details using the AI.

req.description: Request body containing data to be processed for summary generation.

example_uses: Process this dataset to get a summary of key trends.
Generate detailed insights from the provided financial data.
Use the AI to summarize the meeting notes.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user has structured or unstructured data that needs AI-driven summarization or detailed extraction.

endpoints.name: UpdateAiAssistantAccessibility
endpoints.description: Updates the accessibility settings or preferences for the AI assistant.

req.description: Request body containing accessibility settings to update.

example_uses: Change the AI assistant's response verbosity.
Update my accessibility preferences for Gemini.
Configure the AI to use a different output format.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to modify how the AI assistant interacts with them, such as visual or auditory settings, or response styles.

endpoints.name: UpdateSessionStar
endpoints.description: Marks or unmarks an AI assistant chat session as 'starred' for easy retrieval or prioritization.

req.description: Request body containing session ID and star status.

example_uses: Star this important AI chat session.
Mark session 456 as a favorite.
Unstar the session about the old project.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to highlight or unhighlight a specific AI assistant session for future reference.

endpoints.name: UpdateSessionArchive
endpoints.description: Archives or unarchives an AI assistant chat session, moving it to or from an archived state.

req.description: Request body containing session ID and archive status.

example_uses: Archive this completed AI chat session.
Move session 789 to the archives.
Restore the archived session about the Q1 report.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to manage the visibility or retention of AI assistant sessions by archiving them.

endpoints.name: UpdateSessionTitle
endpoints.description: Updates the custom title of an AI assistant chat session.

req.description: Request body containing session ID and new title.

example_uses: Rename this AI chat session to 'Project X Discussion'.
Change the title of session 101 to 'Budget Planning'.
Update the session title for my conversation about marketing strategies.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to give a more descriptive or custom title to an AI assistant session.

endpoints.name: GenerateAndStoreEmbeddings
endpoints.description: Triggers the generation and storage of vector embeddings for a specified entity, used for semantic search.

entityName.description: The name of the entity for which to generate embeddings (e.g., 'Documents', 'Products').

example_uses: Generate embeddings for all product data.
Create vector representations for the new policy documents.
Update the embeddings for the 'Partners' entity.
endpoints.when_to_use: When new data is added or existing data is updated for an entity, and its semantic representations (embeddings) need to be generated or refreshed for search capabilities.

endpoints.name: BulkUpload
endpoints.description: Facilitates the bulk upload of data or files into the system for processing.

req.description: Request body containing the bulk upload data or file references.

example_uses: Perform a bulk upload of all new customer records.
Import multiple documents at once using the bulk upload feature.
Upload a large dataset for analysis.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user needs to import a large volume of data or multiple files into the system efficiently.

endpoints.name: AnalyseFile
endpoints.description: Analyzes an uploaded file to extract metadata, content, or prepare it for further processing.

request.description: Request body containing file details for analysis.

example_uses: Analyze the structure and content of the uploaded PDF.
Perform a preliminary analysis on the new spreadsheet.
Check the attached document for compliance issues.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user has uploaded a file and needs to perform an initial analysis or validation on its content.

endpoints.name: GetSimilarityResultAsync
endpoints.description: Performs a semantic or similarity search across entities, optionally filtered by Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

entityName.description: Name of the entity to search (e.g., 'Partners', 'Contacts').

vectorEmbedding.description: Optional vector embedding for semantic search.

example_uses: Find documents similar to 'project proposal' in the 'Documents' entity.
Search for contacts related to 'sustainable development' using semantic search.
Retrieve partners that are similar to 'UNICEF' with a high similarity score.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user needs to perform an intelligent search based on semantic meaning or similarity, rather than exact keyword matching, across various data entities.

endpoints.name: GenerateTitle
endpoints.description: Generates a descriptive title for an AI assistant chat session based on its content.

sessionId.description: The ID of the session for which to generate a title.

example_uses: Generate a title for my latest AI chat session.
Can the AI suggest a title for session 222?
Create a summary title for the conversation about the new initiative.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants the AI to automatically create a concise and relevant title for a chat session, typically after the session has concluded or reached a certain length.
